children: on Wednesday named Jack Tobin as chief financial officer, succeeding Lynne Fitzpatrick, who is set to become the derivatives exchange's chief executive next year.
Tobin, who has served as CME's chief accounting officer since 2015, will become deputy CFO in November and assume the position of finance chief in March 2027.
Matthew Render will succeed Tobin as chief accounting officer.
